title: Assemble the first isolated production release candidate
objective: Assemble a deterministic, self-contained @mez-systems/design-system-web 1.0.0-rc.1 package from approved canonical inputs, prove it in isolation and prepare exact redacted operating-proof derivatives for human review without publishing, deploying or entering a consumer repository.

included: copy approved canonical inputs into a versioned release-candidate package
rebase every runtime import and asset URL to package-local entrypoints
include CMP-05 and CMP-06 only within their separate approved authority scopes
generate an integrity manifest, version export, package verifier and deterministic rebuild receipt
prepare separate redacted derivatives of the four operating-proof screenshots while preserving original hashes and excluding original paths and bytes
run a package-only clean-copy proof with the canonical checkout inaccessible to the test process
prove responsive, keyboard, focus, screen-reader structure, reduced-motion, no-WebGL and missing-media states across the declared viewports
present the exact release-candidate bytes and exact redacted proof derivatives at a human gate
excluded: deploying any website or modifying a consumer repository
inventing or changing testimonial content, follower values or consent state
changing the locked CMP-05 treatment or CMP-06 presentation
including raw operating-proof screenshots, absolute workstation paths or unreviewed derivatives
live routes, analytics, SEO, payments, authentication or product availability
widening either component motion exception or Website Motion 1.0.0

acceptance: the package is deterministic and every included byte is integrity-manifested
all runtime imports, assets, fonts, licences, schemas and validators resolve package-locally
the package verifier passes from an isolated copy without network or canonical-checkout access
no raw or unreviewed operating-proof media enters the package
the release candidate exposes package name, version and manifest hash without claiming production release authority
each derivative is separate from its evidence original and preserves the original SHA-256 in provenance
redaction methods, derivative SHA-256, alt text and exact review state are recorded
publicReleaseEligible remains false until Olli visually approves the exact derivative bytes

verification.passCondition: two clean assemblies produce the same manifest and the included verifier passes from the isolated copy
the isolated package makes zero runtime design-network calls and contains no canonical-checkout or absolute workstation path
the isolated example preserves complete responsive, keyboard, focus, screen-reader structure and reduced-motion meaning at 320 through 1440
Olli approves the exact redacted operating-proof derivative bytes and the exact release candidate for named-consumer proof

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Do the exact isolated 1.0.0-rc.1 package and exact redacted operating-proof derivatives advance to named-consumer proof, remain candidate for revision, or get rejected?

stopConditions: an input lacks canonical authority or an integrity-manifested bounded approval source
an import, font, asset or validator resolves outside the package during isolated proof
a raw screenshot, original workstation path or unreviewed proof derivative would enter the package
the package changes approved component or Golden Homepage visual behaviour without a new bounded review
the task requires a consumer repository, deployment, publishing or production version assignment
a verifier passes while the rendered isolated surface is visually or accessibly incomplete
notes: PORT-02 is complete and authorises release-candidate assembly, not production release.
The package remains an approved candidate, not a production release.
Olli approved the four exact redacted derivative bytes and the distinct exact package at H-PORT-03-PRODUCTION-RELEASE-CANDIDATE on 2026-07-28.
